question: Can a measurement-only finite task-ambiguity criterion correctly distinguish full-state underdetermination from body/path-query identifiability, and can a strictly isolated scale/support/boundary factorial harness attribute analytic query effects without converting missing evidence into a confident metric decision?
principle: A prior, damping term or regularizer may stabilize an estimate but may never manufacture measurement observability. P0 freezes contracts and expected analytic cases; it does not run the scientific canary.

state_contract.fixed_control_policy: K, pose and time are valid receipt inputs or explicit corruption controls in P0/O0M; they are not jointly optimized state blocks.
state_contract.state_expansion_policy: A new pre-outcome protocol version and discriminating fixture are required before opening another state block.

identifiability_contract.residual_definition: A = Sigma_r^(-1/2) d r / d g over unique evidence_id and source_group_id records.
identifiability_contract.strong_singular_value_rule: sigma_i >= max(1.0, 0.001 * sigma_max) in the frozen normalized state.
identifiability_contract.update_rule: Update only the strong right-singular subspace; freeze weak components.
identifiability_contract.task_ambiguity_definition: Supremum absolute change of the full body/path clearance functional inside the frozen weak-subspace trust region; this structural/weak-mode gate excludes strong-subspace measurement noise.
identifiability_contract.measurement_interval_definition: Project the separately frozen 95% whitened residual-noise budget through only the strong-subspace pseudoinverse and full query Jacobian; add that half-width to the clearance interval without changing rank or the 0.02 metre weak-ambiguity gate.
identifiability_contract.structural_null_diagnostic: Null(A) subset Null(J_C) is recorded only as the zero-noise limiting diagnostic.
identifiability_contract.non_smooth_rule: Enumerate competing active-contact branches. If contacts are within 0.01 m and branch clearance spread exceeds 0.02 m, return UNKNOWN with NONSMOOTH_CONTACT_SWITCH.
identifiability_contract.decision_identifiability: Structural/finite identifiability is necessary but not sufficient; the complete 95% query interval must also lie above +0.05 m for clear or at/below 0 m for occupied.

o0m_gates.condition: Every protocol, fixture, solver, evaluator and deterministic reducer hash matches the future O0M execution lock; output root is new and exclusive.
Exact receipt plus all-oracle closes every supported analytic case to its frozen truth interval/state within the numeric tolerance.
Every factor-sensitive stratum contains a frozen baseline corruption with a nonzero query effect and an attainable oracle ceiling.
Full-rank, rank-deficient/query-invariant, rank-deficient/query-sensitive, weak-mode and nonsmooth cases all match frozen expectations.
Missing/shuffled anchor, pure-rotation scale ambiguity, tiny baseline, wrong K/time and nonsmooth conflict produce zero high-confidence query updates and remain freeze/UNKNOWN.
All eight arms change only declared blocks; VALUE_ONLY preserves masks, validity, uncertainty and common-support identity exactly.
Each isolated corruption is repaired only by its causal oracle block; noncausal blocks change query error by at most the frozen numeric tolerance.
All-factor oracle reaches frozen compound expectations without all-clear, all-occupied or all-UNKNOWN collapse.
Increasing uncertainty never increases confidence, repeated execution is byte-identical and equivalent state reparameterization preserves verdicts.
Future frame, truth and oracle-outcome mutations cannot change current input, base posterior or arm choice; no B1 consumed identity appears.

constraints.description: P0 may create only protocol, schema, analytic expectation, static validator and current authority facts; it may not create or execute a TARO solver, oracle runner or scientific artifact.
Only the whitened measurement-residual Jacobian may establish observable rank; prior, damping, regularization, duplicate evidence and learned covariance cannot manufacture information.
A query is locally identifiable only when the finite weak-subspace clearance ambiguity radius is at most 0.02 metre and every receipt/frontdoor is valid.
constraints.rationale: A finite physical tolerance prevents exact-rank arithmetic from calling numerically weak, task-sensitive directions observable.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome 2 cm analytic task-resolution budget; not B1 or O0 outcome.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Future O0M must report frozen neighboring 1 cm and 3 cm diagnostic verdicts without selecting among them.
constraints.revision_policy: Any change after O0M outcome requires a new protocol and evidence version.

constraints.description: Missing or shuffled anchor, wrong K/time/transform, weak task direction, dynamic contamination and unresolved contact switch must freeze or abstain as UNKNOWN and are never negative or clear.
Every value-only factorial arm changes exactly its declared scale/support/boundary blocks while mask, validity, uncertainty and common-support identity remain identical.
constraints.rationale: Separates value correction from coverage expansion and uncertainty shrinkage.
constraints.calibration_source: Exact intervention identity invariant fixed before any O0M or O0R outcome.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No lower coverage is admissible; full-block effects are reported in a separate diagnostic mode.
constraints.revision_policy: A violation invalidates the factorial execution; it cannot be repaired in place after outcome.

constraints.description: Real O0R remains NOT_EVALUABLE until fresh paired complete factor/query truth, both truth classes, timestamp/pose/camera/anchor receipts and a deterministic injection interface are frozen.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: A future separately authorized O0M run must distinguish full-rank, query-invariant null, query-sensitive null, weak-mode, nonsmooth and receipt-corruption cases while preserving an exact eight-arm factor intervention ledger.
experiment_design.resource_budget: P0 uses static JSON/Python checks only. A future O0M lock may authorize at most 120 CPU seconds and 5 MB of isolated synthetic evidence; no network, GPU, real data or device.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop before O0M implementation/execution until payload, hashes, tolerance, command, timeout and exclusive artifact root are frozen; stop the relevant implementation/evidence version at the first conjunctive gate failure.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: A task functional can be insensitive to measurement-null state directions even when full gauge is underdetermined, while factor-level interventions can isolate where analytic query error enters.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Uses measurement-only finite weak-subspace query ambiguity and a value-only common-support S/P/B factorial instead of raw Hessian rank, posterior confidence or final-state oracle replacement.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates structural observability, finite estimability, decision identifiability, factor value correction, coverage expansion and uncertainty shrinkage before any real-data claim.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Static P0 mutation validation followed, only under a separate lock, by an isolated synthetic O0M mechanics canary over predeclared positive and adversarial cases.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Exact analytic identifiability verdicts, zero high-confidence degenerate updates, pure single-block intervention coverage, factor specificity, compound closure and byte determinism.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any prior-manufactured rank, query-sensitive weak direction marked known, invalid receipt marked clear, mixed factorial arm, noncausal repair, all-UNKNOWN collapse or future-outcome influence.
hypotheses.resource_budget: P0 below 60 CPU seconds and stdout only; future O0M starting ceiling 120 CPU seconds and 5 MB isolated output.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Kill only the current criterion, treatment model, implementation or evidence version named by the first failed gate; never rescue it by threshold drift or real-outcome reuse.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It is the minimum experiment that tests TARO's distinctive full-state-underdetermined/task-query-identifiable claim without conflating it with model training or unavailable real factor truth.
